name: helpdesk_auto
summary: Event-driven automation rule engine with versioning, dry-run and execution logs
description: A WHEN/IF/THEN automation engine that reacts to ticket create/update and state, priority or assignee changes, plus scheduled sweeps. Conditions combine with all/any logic; actions perform typed ticket mutations (set state/priority/team/assignee/category, add note, add tag, escalate). Rules are explicitly versioned and published, support dry-run test runs against a sample ticket, apply-once and emergency disable, with loop prevention via a security-bypass apply path and a full execution log per rule/ticket.
author: Nexa
